documentation.cara_kerja: Monitor kompetitor melalui: (1) Product pricing pages, (2) Job postings (hiring signals), (3) Press releases & blog posts, (4) Social media engagement metrics. Agregasi ke unified competitive intelligence dashboard.
documentation.fungsi: Menghasilkan Competitive Positioning Map, Pricing Trend Analysis, Hiring Velocity Index, dan Strategic Move Alerts.
documentation.tujuan: Early warning system untuk competitive threats dan identification of market opportunities berdasarkan sinyal publik kompetitor.
